description.value: Dolly's Fish Market Restaurant is a licensed seafood restaurant and working fish market on the waterfront Cow Bay strip in Prince Rupert, one of the northernmost communities on BC's coast. It is part of a multi-location Northern BC operation that combines a sit-down restaurant with fresh seafood retail, custom and commercial fish processing, and wholesale sales. Cow Bay is a well-known visitor destination, making this a natural meal stop for cyclists arriving by ferry or touring the Yellowhead corridor.
